notes.title: Version 1.0.177 Update is Available
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, Happy Sheepies Community![/b]

We thank you all for your overwhelming support which greatly exceeded our expectations! It melts our hearts to know that, thousands of people have had exciting hours with our little sheep-farming game.

First of all, we should say that we are a husband and wife team and we are very approachable 7/26 via our [url=https://discord.gg/VyesyHV8T7]Discord[/url] server! We consider every suggestion/idea/feedback/criticism and are working hard to implement them to make Happy Sheepies the best game about the sheepies in the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947659/13a0be056faeaf21f0e4efb51b0555a8b864bc85.gif[/img]


[b]Here is the first after-launch update notes of Happy Sheepies[/b] 
with your precious feedback, and what we sprinkle on top of it:

[list]
[*] Fullscreen and scalable Windowed Mode options are added in the Settings menu.
[*] Losing Empty Sacks with the Composter in progress bug is fixed.
[*] The paper count of the Packaging Table is increased from 5 to 10.
[*] The Tough Times quest's gold coins need is decreased from 150 to 100.
[*] An Ambiance sound level slider has been added to the settings.
[*] A Settings button has been added to the in-game menu.
[*] The Resource Capacity is activated on the Market earlier when the Farm Area I quest is done.
[*] Carrot Trough has been added as a Structure.
[*] The Sewing Tools item has been made a bit bigger to make it easier to hold and drag.
[*] Now, you can get Water from the Water Trough with an Empty Bucket.
[*] No-capacity indicators have been made a bit bigger.
[*] Lots of minor Polish and German translation issues are fixed.
[*] 5 Resource Capacity reward added to the Using Fertilizers quest reward.
[*] Settings Menu has been redesigned.
[*] The game icon changed to a better-quality one.
[*] The maximum raw meat count can be obtained based on the sheep's weight when you butcher a sheep has been decreased to 8.
[*] The Wool Washer market price has been decreased from 90 to 45.
[*] The Wool Dryer market price has been decreased from 40 to 35.
[*] The selling price of the Cheeseburger has been increased to 48.
[*] The selling price of the Cheese has been increased to 17.
[*] The selling price of the Stomach has been decreased to 10.
[*] The selling price of the Steak Sandwich has been increased to 23.
[*] The selling price of Abomasum has been decreased to 9.
[/list]
We also made a lot of minor fixes and optimizations.

If you have any ideas, feature requests, or encounter any kind of bug, please don't hesitate to tell us!
[url=https://discord.gg/VyesyHV8T7]Click here to join our Discord.[/url]

Hope you enjoy v.1.0.177! 

Thanks, 
Berker Games
